title: Algebraization of the pullback to a Chow modification
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian I-adically complete ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let f:Z -> Spec A be separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with Z Noetherian and nonempty. Let Q=I O_Z and G in Coh(Z,Q) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] have first support proper over A [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. There exist Y, a proper morphism q:Y -> Z, a quasi-coherent ideal L on Z, and a coherent module F on Y [pqf-def-coherent], such that Z minus V(L) is nonempty, q is an isomorphism after base change to this open, the inverse system q^*G is isomorphic to the completion of F for Q O_Y, and q_*F has support proper over A.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: Obtain Y, q, L, n, e, the immersion proof, the equation over Spec A, and the nonempty isomorphism open from exists_chow_modification_data. Install IsProper q and IsImmersion e. Pass n, e, and its equation to exists_chow_algebraization_data to obtain F, the completion isomorphism, and proper support of q_*F. Assemble the original existential conclusion, forgetting only the auxiliary projective immersion data.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chowPullbackAlgebraization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (hZ : Nonempty Z) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) (_ : IsProper q) (L : Z.IdealSheafData)
      (F : CoherentModules Y),
      (L.support.compl : Set Z).Nonempty ∧
      IsIso (pullback.snd q (Scheme.Opens.ι L.support.compl)) ∧
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj)
